Local polls from the University of New Hampshire Survey Center have also found Trump's approval hitting new lows in Vermont and New Hampshire.

results.content: Donald Trump’s net approval rating has fallen to -27, a new record low, according to The Economist’s tracker of YouGov polling. The administration’s resumption of strikes on Iran in mid-July may be to blame. Since then both sides have been locked in a cycle of fighting and half-baked attempts at a ceasefire.
